BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_REPLAY.description: At the start of your turn, if this card is in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], play it. Triggers up to [blue]3[/blue] times each combat.
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_REPLAY.title: Replay
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_FORCE_DEATH.descripti: Forced Death cannot be prevented by [gold]Undead[/gold], [gold]Intangible[/gold], or any other effect.
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_FORCE_DEATH.title: Forced Death
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_KILL.description: The total incoming enemy attack damage is greater than or equal to your current HP, Block, Plating, and Osty's current HP combined.
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_KILL.title: Kill
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_ENCORE.description: After you manually play this card, automatically play it at the start of your next turn once for each time it has been played this combat. Automatic plays count as plays, but do not schedule further Encore plays.
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_ENCORE.title: Encore
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_KILLING_BLOW.descript: Deal damage with this card and kill an enemy.
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_KILLING_BLOW.title: Killing Blow
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_SAN.description: The shared sanity value for the hand mirror series. Starts at [blue]50[/blue] and persists across the run. Taking attack damage that causes HP loss reduces SAN by [blue]5[/blue]; multi-hit attacks count each hit separately. Winning combat increases SAN by [blue]20[/blue], up to [blue]80[/blue]. At [blue]100[/blue] or higher SAN, enter [gold]Rationality[/gold]: all enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold], and you cannot gain Status cards during combat. When leaving Rationality, lose [blue]1[/blue] Energy and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold]. At [red]-100[/red] or lower SAN, enter low SAN: cards you draw randomly transform for this combat into character cards, Curses, or Statuses; transformed cards are upgraded, and your damage dealt and damage taken are both increased by [green]50%[/green].
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_SAN.title: SAN
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_TEXAS_HOLDEM_RULES.de: Suit-enchanted cards in your hand use their enchantment stacks as ranks. Your strongest [gold]Texas Hold'em[/gold] hand is chosen from [gold]Pair[/gold], [gold]Two Pair[/gold], [gold]Three of a Kind[/gold], [gold]Straight[/gold], [gold]Flush[/gold], [gold]Full House[/gold], [gold]Four of a Kind[/gold], [gold]Straight Flush[/gold], and [gold]Royal Flush[/gold]. An Ace can be low ([blue]1[/blue]) or high in [blue]10-J-Q-K-A[/blue]. Hand members trigger their Suit effects without spending remaining triggers or their once-per-combat trigger, even if they already triggered this combat. A Straight Flush triggers each member [blue]2[/blue] times; a Royal Flush triggers each member [blue]3[/blue] times.
